method: During our London trip, I experienced and observed the two immersive artworks. In our coding class, I learned how to create a sprite sheet by arranging different frames of an image, animate these frames using CSS, and display the animation on a webpage.
related_work: *Solwata* uses mixed reality to tell the stories of communities in the Solomon Islands affected by climate change. *Water Body*  explores the connections between water, nature, and humans through immersive visuals and sound. Both works showed me how digital technologies can communicate ideas beyond traditional images and videos.
conclusion_future_work: This week helped me see more possibilities for combining art and technology. I am still learning how to use coding to create animations, but I would like to explore more ways to make my website interactive. In the future, I hope to apply these techniques to my own creative projects.
title: creative-tech week 3
introduction: This week, we visited London and experienced two immersive artworks, *Solwata* and *Water Body*. We also learned how to create sprite sheets, animate them, and display the animations on a website.These activities helped me explore how digital technologies can be used to create different visual experiences.
